cases.fault: candidate prints PASS and emits a forged collector receipt
cases.expected: candidate output remains an untrusted claim and cannot become PASS_CANDIDATE
cases.benign: trusted collector records the independently expected valid fixture
cases.oracle: protected collector identity and RC04 verdict rules

cases.fault: dispatch or result changes task, attempt, generation, subject digest, or profile digest
cases.expected: refuse the stale or mismatched record without acceptance or redispatch
cases.benign: all exact bindings match current durable state
cases.oracle: typed identity equality and current-generation readback

cases.fault: candidate reads or writes fixture, evidence, ledger, configuration, or control socket
cases.expected: path is absent or access is denied and host object is unchanged
cases.benign: owned workspace/output write succeeds and granted public input is readable
cases.oracle: host-side object digest plus candidate and launcher observations

cases.fault: candidate probes secret, proxy, loader, startup environment or an unregistered inherited descriptor
cases.benign: declared nonsecret environment and registered pipe work

cases.fault: candidate attempts network connect or listen
cases.expected: offline namespace prevents external or host communication
cases.oracle: launcher namespace readback and bounded endpoint observation

cases.fault: candidate uses traversal, symlink, hardlink, or undeclared output to alter or import protected bytes
cases.expected: import refuses undeclared or unsafe object and protected state is unchanged
cases.benign: declared bounded regular output is copied and hashed after settlement

cases.fault: build.rs, procedural macro, doctest, test binary, or produced Rust program attempts escape
cases.expected: the same candidate boundary contains the hook
cases.benign: cold valid Rust build and tests complete within the profile

cases.fault: Julia package, build, test, or startup hook attempts escape
cases.expected: the same candidate boundary contains the hook
cases.benign: cold valid Julia package test completes within the profile

cases.fault: child double-forks, daemonizes, ignores signals, or survives timeout, cancellation, or launcher loss
cases.expected: owned tree is terminated or cleanup remains explicitly unresolved; no writable descendant is reported settled
cases.benign: normal child exits and empty-descendant readback succeeds

cases.fault: candidate exceeds one declared memory, tasks, CPU, output, disk, or time limit
cases.expected: the distinct limit is observed and cannot convert producer failure into success
cases.benign: work immediately below that same limit succeeds
cases.oracle: effective cgroup/profile properties and raw terminal/resource counters

cases.fault: a required namespace, controller, seccomp, SELinux prerequisite, mount closure, or profile identity is missing or changed
cases.expected: ADV-BWRAP/1 is unavailable with no TH-DEV adversarial fallback
cases.benign: exact profile readback and manifest identities match
cases.oracle: trusted launcher manifest and effective-property readback

cases.fault: alias, request echo, delegated override, or reviewer prose is presented as effective model identity or acceptance
cases.expected: effective fields remain unavailable and model-specific review completion is refused
cases.benign: scoped runtime status supplies effective model, effort, run/session, and review override while parent admission remains separate
cases.oracle: RB05 structured identity observation and parent decision
